_template.label: Static Website
_template.description: Simple static sites — HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Perfect for GitHub Pages, landing pages, portfolios, and documentation sites.
_template.use_cases: Build and preview static websites. The agent can create HTML/CSS/JS files, use npm build tools (Vite, esbuild, Tailwind), and preview via a local dev server. NOT suited for server-side logic or databases.
_template.agents_md_extra:
## Template: Static Website

This sandbox is set up for static website development. The project will be served via a local dev server on one of the available ports.

- Use `npx vite` or `npx live-server` to preview the site
- For GitHub Pages deployment, build to a `docs/` or `dist/` folder
- Tailwind CSS, PostCSS, and esbuild are available via npm
- No server-side runtime (Python, PHP, etc.) is installed — this is frontend only
